narrative: [PLACEHOLDER] It was 2 AM when the alert fired. A major retail chain's customer database had been exfiltrated — 14 million records, gone in under an hour.
[PLACEHOLDER] Six months earlier, a security firm had offered to run a penetration test on the same infrastructure. The offer was declined. Too expensive, too disruptive.
[PLACEHOLDER] The total breach cost? $47 million. The penetration test quote? $35,000.
[PLACEHOLDER] This is why ethical hackers exist — not to cause harm, but to find the holes before the criminals do.

characters.name: Alex Chen
characters.description: [PLACEHOLDER] A certified ethical hacker with 8 years of experience helping organisations find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them.

characters.name: Maria Santos
characters.description: [PLACEHOLDER] Chief Information Security Officer who learned the hard way that prevention is always cheaper than breach response.
